title: Plumbix pipeline, format version 1
description: Schema for .plumbix/pipeline.yaml, the pipeline that judges changes, and for the triggered pipelines under .plumbix/pipelines/<name>.yaml (WU-045). Plumbix also enforces: on is required in a triggered pipeline and not allowed in .plumbix/pipeline.yaml, top-level disabled and source are allowed only in a triggered pipeline, and a triggered pipeline has no validator steps; rules that span fields, which this schema cannot express: step names are unique; every name in needs refers to another existing step, appears once, and is not a validator step; needs contain no cycles; a secret name is not also an env key; timeout is above zero and at most 24h; allow_failure, when and cache are not set on validator steps; reviewer, advisory, effort and external are set only on validator steps and such a step has no image, run, env, secrets or retries; every step named in stages exists, is not a validator and is in one stage only.

on.description: What starts a triggered pipeline (WU-045). Only in files under .plumbix/pipelines/, where it is required.

push.description: Run when a matching branch moves: on every push, including Plumbix merges. With paths, only when a file changed since the branch's previous head matches; a new branch always runs.

items.description: Glob; * and ? match within a segment, ** matches any number of segments.
Glob; * and ? match within a segment, ** matches any number of segments.

manual.description: A person may start the pipeline at a branch head.

disabled.description: The whole pipeline does not run (WU-045): the step reasons plus trigger, for a pipeline started in a way Plumbix cannot run yet (tags, schedules, manual parameters).

source.description: Which source pipeline an import made this one from (WU-048). Only in files under .plumbix/pipelines/. A re-check matches the file to its source pipeline by system and file. written is a SHA-256 of the pipeline's own fields as the import wrote them (everything except steps, stages and source, taken over the parsed content); when they no longer match, a person edited them and a re-check keeps them.

system.description: The CI system, such as azure.

stages.description: Named groups of steps, for display and run evidence. A step is in at most one stage; validators are never in a stage.

varName.description: Environment variable or secret name. Names starting with PLUMBIX_ are reserved.

image.description: Container image the step runs in.

run.description: Shell script run with sh -c, or a list of commands run in order as one script that stops at the first failure. Required unless the step is a validator.

needs.description: Steps that must succeed before this one starts.

secrets.description: Names of secrets exposed to this step only, as environment variables.

cache.description: Absolute container paths kept between runs of this repository, such as /go/pkg/mod or /root/.npm: each is a per-repository directory mounted read-write. Not for validators; not the root, the workspace or inside it; at most 8.

artifacts.description: Workspace-relative paths kept as evidence after the step.

validator.description: Marks a validator step. It has no run: the image's entrypoint is the validator, started with the change's inputs mounted read-only at /plumbix/in and the workspace at /workspace, and it must write /plumbix/out/verdict.json. Plumbix ships plumbix-reference-validator and plumbix-ai-validator (built from validators/ in its repository); any image honouring the validator contract works.

retries.description: How many more times a failed or timed-out step is run. Only the last attempt counts.

allow_failure.description: A failed or timed-out step does not fail the run and does not skip the steps that need it. Not for validators.

external.description: The validator's verdict comes from a reviewer outside the pipeline: Plumbix publishes a review brief and waits, bounded by timeout (default one hour). Only for validators; no image, run, env, secrets or retries.

effort.description: The reasoning effort of the model that judges this validator step, overriding its reviewer profile: low, medium or high. Only for validators.

advisory.description: The validator's verdict is recorded in the run, tagged advisory, but never counted: it cannot approve, reject, request fixes, judge a criterion or call for a human. For comparing a second model. Only for validators.

reviewer.description: The reviewer profile (Settings, AI reviewers) that judges this validator step: its provider, endpoint, model, key and tool policy. Only for validators; the default profile applies when absent.

when.description: Run condition. For a change's run the step runs only if a changed file matches one of the globs; a plain branch run always runs it. Not for validators.

items.description: Relative glob; * and ? match within a segment, ** matches any number of segments.

disabled.description: The step does not run, and neither does any pipeline that holds it (WU-044). Imported steps Plumbix cannot run yet carry the reason that blocks them; a person may disable a step with reason user. A disabled step needs neither image nor run.

reason.description: user: disabled by a person; docker: uses Docker itself; services: needs service containers beside it; host: runs on the build agent's machine with no image; task: a source CI task with no Plumbix equivalent; template: from a template Plumbix could not read; condition: a run condition Plumbix cannot express; checkout: needs another repository checked out; deployment: deploys to an environment or waits for an approval; secrets: needs variables or secret groups not mapped to Plumbix secrets; variables: uses variables or expressions of the source CI system that Plumbix cannot resolve.

note.description: Free text: what the step did in its source, or why a person disabled it.

source.description: Where an imported step came from (WU-046): the source CI file, the line of the job and a SHA-256 of the job, so a re-check can see what changed at the source. written (WU-048) is a SHA-256 of the step as the import wrote it, without source, taken over its parsed content; a step that no longer matches was edited by a person and a re-check keeps it. Ignored when running.
